jelly-death.text: A single raw egg breaking on a stone surface. A brief delicate eggshell crack immediately followed by a thick wet yolk splat and tiny shell fragments settling. Compact, tactile, slightly grotesque and darkly comic. Rounded wet body, restrained brittle detail, short natural decay. Close dry isolated game sound. No glass shattering, explosive impact, exaggerated crunch, voice, music or reverb.

jelly-land.text: One large thick water droplet landing softly in a shallow puddle. A rounded low plop, a small wet splash and a brief soft liquid wobble. Gentle attack, compact and weighty, muted high frequencies. A gelatinous body landing. Dry isolated game sound, short tail. No crunch, crack, bones, clicks, slap, sharp impact, voice or music.

spikes.text: One short solid metallic tone, like a single thick brass coin gently struck with a padded mallet. Dense rounded body, one clear midrange pitch with a slight upward bend, soft attack and short damped ring. Simple, compact, dry and close. An understated dungeon trap rising cue. No multiple coins, jingling, rattling, chains, machinery, scraping, sharp treble, melody, voice or music.

spikes-retract.text: One short solid metallic tone, like a single thick brass coin gently struck with a padded mallet. Dense rounded body, one clear midrange pitch with a slight downward bend, soft attack and a damped ring fading smoothly to silence. Simple, compact, dry and close. An understated dungeon trap retracting cue. No multiple coins, jingling, rattling, chains, machinery, scraping, sharp treble, melody, voice or music.

portal.text: One deep muffled liquid glug as a small magical portal swallows a gelatinous creature. A soft hollow underwater bloop with a rounded bassy bubble collapsing inward and a brief gentle liquid wobble. Low-pass filtered, warm low mids, soft onset, short subdued tail. Isolated game sound. No sharp transient, pop, glass, chimes, electric zap, explosive whoosh, voice or music.

dungeon-wind.text: Seamless ambience of low air moving through an ancient underground stone corridor. Hollow drafts, subtle pressure fluctuations and distant airy resonance. Quiet, spacious and uneasy, with no distinct repeating events. No voices, no choir, no music, no sudden sounds.
